folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B387: elapsed support and exact revision proof
folds.body:
The entire checkpoint, V1–V7 table and revision history were read. A just-settled elapsed light interval is not the lamp's current shining state or a cached future quote. Its calendar/place/custody guards and reset on configure/load/command prevent reuse as timeless entitlement. The native reading owner uses supported elapsed illumination while the current estimate reflects expiry. Independent light can support the post-expiry inspection remainder; travel burning fuel does not invent study. Supported compressed advance replays native ticks, not a new offline clock.

F1/F3 were reproduced before edits; F2's stock/command/persistence/custody semantics were retained. Fixture corrections for null/undefined and book progress versus matching Literacy XP preserve loader invariants. Reader title recognition at next publication/load backfill is separate from once-only book work, fuel, XP and bonus: immediate selected-state checks and later whole-envelope checks have different scope. The2335-green revisionB suite follows a real changed other-owner harvest UI input, preserving revisionA's failure and both hash identities. It is not a same-input pointless repeat or a repair attributed to the light lane.

All numeric night/dawn/expiry estimates and native save/reload/Export/Import comparisons retain their exact seeded candidate and original clock sampling policy. The pre-edit purchase journey supports unchanged acquisition only, not final whole-campaign play. Old candidate URLs/paths, symlinked font, writer release and stopped-process claims are historical; no current manifest, runtime, source game, browser or app was reverified. AD42 makes the old remaining human-play gate optional review, without broadening the actual technical evidence.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B387: information flow versus physical authority
folds.body:
The full planner packet, exact record/envelope shapes and five executor bindings were read. Imported/player metadata is not the host's actual operator/subject body, source ownership, learned executable power, anchor or sensory flow. Registry labels do not grant possession, awakening, reach or identity. Activation pays/opens the selected view lease but is not a sample. A sample, detection, notice, deliberate identity claim and qualified identifying evidence have distinct causes/recipients; an anonymous trace and return path do not disclose a hidden operator or move either body.

One staged durable publisher must reconcile positive costs and realm-boundary costs without double debit, execute the actually owned power before adopting the planner proposal, and recheck sequence/revision/cause and exact host support. Blocked plans publish no partial state, costs or knowledge. The view edge differs from physical doorway/contact/cargo; local cooperation/payment still needs actual co-location. Manual shutter, expiry and lost support close their own authorized view while preserving people, stock, prior samples and receipts. Recipient replay returns stored scoped text without a new sample, charge, lease update or clock enrollment.

The packet reports syntax/import evidence and names a separate root/native acceptance backlog. Later helper/checkpoint descriptions do not prove that an exported planner, failed publication or restored lease was exercised. Historical price/lifetime/retention caps remain authored local proposals, not universal once-only limits (AD22). The source reasoning and generated shape do not authenticate current runtime/import invariants or private source truth. No common executor, save, clock or browser was invoked by this reconciliation.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B387: unioned support and final-envelope invariant
folds.body:
The complete103-line delivery, native regrant and final connected source review were read. Visits and supported observation/work intervals form a union, advancing each local minute once; absent/unsupported intervals freeze. Stored active/unexpired status and lastSupportedAt do not establish live continuity. Host-supplied support, exact endpoint/revisions and the earliest pending scheduler boundary remain required. Opening cannot retrospectively enroll an unobserved gap. Reconcile the valid prior interval before support mutation/closure/expiry, and settle a boundary already due before positive advance.

Local scheduling support does not relocate the player, authorize contact/cargo, exempt costs or disclose private completion. Physical passage and live viewing remain different routes. The selected old policy keeps already-paid absolute joined-clock jobs due for settlement while local elapsed time and new resident decisions freeze without support; it is not complete frozen-world simulation, a general job migration or universal offline work entitlement. Missing old namespace stays body-only rather than inventing a live viewer or history.

The final review reports one source-level import-consistency concern: individually valid observer and clock records can lack exact active correspondence at the saved final envelope. This was not a constructed/imported malformed save or fresh current defect proof. If reselected, inspect the actual current final publisher/import validator; do not assert it remains open from this old report. Enforce a required cross-ledger invariant on final publication/import rather than intermediate activation/shutter stages, which intentionally stage observer-before-clock and clock-close-before-observer. Preserve both-absent compatibility and actual native location, without silently relocating a viewer. Syntax/ESM/link checks and release fingerprints establish only those layers; later root changes retain their own identities. No runtime planner, test, build/browser, save, private trial truth or process was exercised here.
